Extension Office
Your local extension office is a tremendous resource for finding information you need. Morton County Extension is located in the County Health and Extension building in Elkhart. We are here to help you answer questions about Livestock and Crops, Health and Nutrition, 4-H/Youth Development, and Horticulture.
Health Care
At Morton County Health System (MCHS) we put the patient first from our amazing staff to our technologies like our patient portal and Tele-medicine services. MCHS is the place that our community can rely in the time of need, we have such a strong community that supports our great health system.
